item.title: Synergistic Electrostatic and Mechanical Anchoring at Cathode–Current Collector Junctions for Durable Sodium‐Ion Batteries
item.description:

Small | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work reveals three synergistic mechanisms—mechanical interlocking, strain-accommodating interlayer, and electrostatic bridging—by which carbon primers reinforce cathode–current collector junctions in sodium-ion batteries. It identifies the junction, not bulk conductivity, as the performance bottleneck, and achieves 88.7% capacity retention over 300 cycles, providing a design framework for durable polyanion-based energy storage.

item.title: Universal Ligand-Field Engineering of Layered Vanadium-Based Cathodes for High-Voltage Aqueous Zinc Ion Batteries
item.description:
پیش‌درج‌شدن BMIM+ در اکسیدهای وانادیم لایه‌ای با تنظیم میدان لیگاند، ولتاژ عملیاتی و پایداری چرخه‌ای باتری آبی یون روی را به‌طور چشمگیری بهبود می‌دهد.
ACS Nano | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work pioneers universal ligand-field engineering via organic cation preintercalation to boost vanadium oxide cathode voltage in aqueous zinc batteries. BMIM+ optimally tunes [VO6] coordination, lowering the V 3d-band center to widen V-O energy separation and raise operating voltage, while achieving 505 mAh g–1 and 94% retention over 15,000 cycles. The strategy generalizes to V6O13 and KV3O8, offering broad design principles.
🏷 aqueous zinc ion battery · vanadium oxide cathode · ligand-field engineering · BMIM+ preintercalation · high operating voltage
